_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#14. A claim about hardware is checked against what the binary reports. ldd on lib4C.so lists 5 Epetra libraries with soname libepetra.so.16 (Trilinos 16) and ZERO CUDA/HIP/SYCL/ROCm runtimes (LINKED_GPU_RUNTIMES=0), so the build has no GPU code path to reach. Running the same HEX8 deck plainly and then with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 KOKKOS_NUM_DEVICES=1 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 KOKKOS_DEVICES=Cuda gives the same exit 0, the same 1 CORRECT result test, an identical abs(diff) (GPU_ENV_CHANGED_THE_ANSWER=no) and not one device/GPU/CUDA message anywhere in the log (GPU_ENV_PRODUCED_ANY_DEVICE_MESSAGE=0) — that is what 'zero effect' means without a stopwatch. Finally 4C's own Teuchos timer table, printed at the end of every run, carries exactly one Epetra class label, 'Epetra_CrsMatrix::Multiply(TransA,X,Y)' with 8 calls, and no Tpetra entry at all (TIMER_LABELS_TPETRA=0): the matrix-vector product this run executed was the Epetra one. Only labels and call counts are asserted; the elapsed columns are deliberately ignored. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: stop asking the binary and count the GPU runtimes in a pattern that always matches something: if the fixture's evidence for CPU-only came from anywhere but ldd on this library, LINKED_GPU_RUNTIMES stops being 0 and the fixture must go red.

read the timer table for the GPU-capable stack instead: if 4C's linear algebra ran on Tpetra rather than Epetra, this is the label that would be there. It is not — TIMER_LABELS_EPETRA becomes 0 and the fixture must go red.
